tools.name: OFAC sanctions screening
tools.summary: Search the official OFAC sanctions list for a person, company, organization, vessel, or other name.
tools.description: OFAC sanctions screening from the official U.S. Treasury source. Returns matching official records and a signed ARAKEL verdict. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Person, company, organization, vessel or other name to screen against OFAC

tools.name: OFAC wallet sanctions screen
tools.summary: Screen a destination crypto wallet address against official U.S. Treasury OFAC sanctions data before sending funds.
tools.description: Crypto wallet sanctions screening using the official OFAC source. Query parameter: q containing the wallet address. Free preflight: /v1/machine/lookup-quote?type=ofac-wallet&q=<wallet>. Returns matching official records and a signed ARAKEL verdict.

q.description: Destination crypto wallet address to screen against OFAC digital currency addresses

tools.name: FDA drug recalls
tools.summary: Search official FDA drug recall and enforcement records by drug, brand, firm, ingredient, or product term.
tools.description: FDA drug recall lookup using official FDA enforcement data. Returns up to 10 matching records plus a signed ARAKEL verdict. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Drug, brand, firm, ingredient or product term

tools.name: FDA food recalls
tools.summary: Search official FDA food recall and enforcement records by product, brand, firm, ingredient, allergen, or reason.
tools.description: FDA food recall lookup using official FDA enforcement data. Returns up to 10 matching records plus a signed ARAKEL verdict. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Food product, brand, firm, ingredient, allergen or recall reason

tools.name: FDA medical device recalls
tools.summary: Search official FDA medical-device recall and enforcement records by device, manufacturer, brand, or product term.
tools.description: FDA medical device recall lookup using official FDA enforcement data. Returns up to 10 matching records plus a signed ARAKEL verdict. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Medical device, manufacturer, brand or product term

tools.name: US federal awards search (USAspending)
tools.summary: Search official USAspending federal award records by recipient, organization, award, contract, or grant term.
tools.description: USAspending federal award search using the official U.S. government source. Returns matching award records plus a signed ARAKEL verdict. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Recipient, organization, award, contract, grant or program term

tools.name: Federal Register search
tools.summary: Search official Federal Register publications by agency, entity, rule, notice, executive order, or topic.
tools.description: Federal Register search over ARAKEL official-source evidence. Returns matching publications plus a signed verdict and coverage metadata. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates.

q.description: Agency, entity, rule, notice, executive order or topic

tools.name: Counterparty government check
tools.summary: Check one counterparty across OFAC sanctions, FDA recalls, USAspending federal awards, and Federal Register records.
tools.description: Compact signed multi-source counterparty check across four official U.S. government evidence sources. Query parameter: q. Optional from/to UTC dates. Payment is not recommended when the result is inconclusive.

q.description: Company, organization, person or counterparty name
